title: Implement Poetry migration for Tactus root package
description: Replace hatch build backend with poetry-core, generate poetry.lock, update CI/docs install flow, and verify with tests and Snyk.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Starting implementation on `feature/poetry-conversion`: migrate root pyproject to poetry-core + lockfile, update CI install flow and docs, then validate with poetry check, quality tests, and Snyk dependency detection.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementation complete on feature branch: migrated root package build backend to poetry-core, added tool.poetry package config, generated poetry.lock, updated release workflow quality-check job to install and run via Poetry, updated README/AGENTS dev setup commands, and aligned declared Python support to >=3.10 due pydantic-ai constraints. Validation run: poetry check, poetry install --extras "dev ml", ruff check, black --check, pytest -m "not integration" (4090 passed), behave --tags=-skip (449 scenarios passed), tactus stdlib test (18 passed), python -m build successful. Snyk CLI now detects Python as Package manager: poetry with Target file: pyproject.toml.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Follow-up consistency updates applied: root Makefile test targets now execute through Poetry (`python3 -m poetry run pytest ...`), `test-ci.sh` now runs pytest through Poetry, and Makefile help text now reflects Python 3.10+ support. Quick verification: `make -n` shows updated commands and `python3 -m poetry run pytest tests/validation/test_semantic_visitor.py -q` passed.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Closing as complete: Poetry root-package implementation is fully landed and active in CI/workflows.
